en.title: Afghan Hound Personalised Urn for Ashes, Handmade Wood with Silver Plated Relief Portrait
en.description:
Made to order, this handmade wooden urn carries a silver plated relief of an Afghan Hound and has a place for the name, dates and a few words about your dog. Keep it where the family gathers, and let the silver relief bring back the face you loved. Share the name, dates and the words you would like, and we will engrave them for you.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Small relief portrait of an Afghan Hound on the front, made of a zinc and aluminium alloy and covered with a layer of silver; the relief cannot be personalised
- Two engraved plaques, one above the other: one with a quote, one with the name and dates
- External size: 21 x 29 x 11 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 4.3 in)
- Internal size: 21 x 14 x 5 cm (8.3 x 5.5 x 2.0 in), capacity approx. 1.5 litres (92 cubic inches)
- Carved wooden decorations
- Removable lid, not sealed: glue it with any all-purpose glue to close it tightly

THE SILVER RELIEF
On the right of the front panel sits a small relief with the head of an Afghan Hound, finished with a layer of silver that gives it a soft shine against the dark wood. It rests beside two engraved plaques, one above the other, with your words, the name and the dates.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name and dates: the name and dates for the lower plaque, in any format you like.
- Quote: the upper plaque carries "You left our lives, but you will never leave our hearts" unless you give us your own exact wording.
- The relief cannot be personalised.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved companion with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

pl.title: Chart afgański personalizowana urna na prochy psa, ręcznie robiona, drewniana z posrebrzanym portretem rasy
pl.description:

CO WARTO WIEDZIEĆ O URNIE

- Mały relief rasy (Chart afgański) na przodzie, ze stopu cynku i aluminium, pokryty warstwą srebra; relief nie podlega personalizacji
- Dwie grawerowane tabliczki, jedna nad drugą: jedna z cytatem, druga z imieniem i datami życia
- Wymiary zewnętrzne: 21 x 29 x 11 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 4,3 cala)
- Wymiary wewnętrzne: 21 x 14 x 5 cm (8,3 x 5,5 x 2,0 cala), pojemność ok. 1,5 litra (92 cale sześcienne)

- Zdejmowane wieczko, które nie jest szczelne: aby zamknąć urnę szczelnie, przyklej je dowolnym klejem uniwersalnym

SREBRNY RELIEF
Po prawej stronie przedniej ścianki znajduje się mały relief z głową rasy Chart afgański, pokryty warstwą srebra, która nadaje mu miękki połysk na tle ciemnego drewna. Obok niego są dwie grawerowane tabliczki, jedna nad drugą, z Twoimi słowami, imieniem i datami życia.

Każda urna powstaje na zamówienie. Podaj nam:
- Imię i daty życia: imię i daty życia na dolnej tabliczce, w dowolnym formacie.
- Cytat: górna tabliczka zawiera napis "You left our lives, but you will never leave our hearts" (tylko po angielsku), chyba że podasz własne, dokładne brzmienie.

Będzie dla nas zaszczytem, jeśli pomożemy Ci z godnością pożegnać ukochanego towarzysza.

nl.title: Afghaanse windhond gepersonaliseerde urn voor hondenas, handgemaakt, hout met verzilverd rasportret

- Twee gegraveerde plaatjes boven elkaar: één met een citaat, één met de naam en levensdata

Aan de rechterkant van de voorkant zit een klein reliëf met de kop van het ras Afghaanse windhond, bedekt met een laagje zilver dat het een zachte glans geeft tegen het donkere hout. Ernaast zitten twee gegraveerde plaatjes boven elkaar met uw woorden, de naam en levensdata.

Elke urn wordt op bestelling gemaakt. Laat ons weten:
- Naam en levensdata: de naam en levensdata voor het onderste plaatje, in elk gewenst formaat.
- Citaat: het bovenste plaatje draagt de tekst "You left our lives, but you will never leave our hearts" (alleen in het Engels), tenzij u ons uw eigen exacte tekst geeft.
- Het reliëf kan niet worden gepersonaliseerd.

Het zou ons een eer zijn om u te helpen op waardige wijze afscheid te nemen van uw hond.

Realizzata su ordinazione, questa urna in legno fatta a mano con rilievo argentato della razza Border Terrier ha uno spazio per nome, date di vita e alcune parole dedicate al suo cane. La forma compatta si colloca comodamente su una mensola, una credenza o un davanzale, ovunque ami ricordare il suo cane. Ogni urna viene realizzata su ordinazione: ci indichi nome e date di vita per una targhetta e sull'altra mantenga le nostre parole o scelga le sue.

DA SAPERE SULL'URNA
- Urna in legno fatta a mano per le ceneri di animali, in legno massello e compensato, dipinta di marrone
- Piccolo rilievo della razza Border Terrier sul fronte, in lega di zinco e alluminio, rivestito con uno strato d'argento; il rilievo non può essere personalizzato
- Due targhette incise, una sopra l'altra: una con una citazione, una con nome e date di vita
- Dimensioni esterne: 21 x 29 x 11 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 4,3 pollici)
- Dimensioni interne: 21 x 14 x 5 cm (8,3 x 5,5 x 2,0 pollici), capacità circa 1,5 litri (92 pollici cubi)
- Decorazioni in legno intagliato
- Coperchio rimovibile, non a tenuta: per chiudere bene l'urna lo incolli con una colla universale

IL RILIEVO ARGENTATO
Sul lato destro del fronte si trova un piccolo rilievo con la testa della razza Border Terrier, rivestito con uno strato d'argento che gli dà una morbida lucentezza sul legno scuro. Accanto ci sono due targhette incise, una sopra l'altra, con le Sue parole, il nome e le date di vita.

PERSONALIZZAZIONE
Ogni urna viene realizzata su ordinazione. Ci indichi:
- Nome e date di vita: nome e date di vita per la targhetta inferiore, in qualsiasi formato.
- Citazione: la targhetta superiore riporta la frase "You left our lives, but you will never leave our hearts" (solo in inglese), a meno che ci indichi il Suo testo esatto.
- Il rilievo non può essere personalizzato.

Ha domande sulla personalizzazione dell'urna? Ci scriva, saremo lieti di aiutarla.

Sarà un onore per noi aiutarla a dire addio con dignità al suo cane.

ORDINI INTERNAZIONALI
I nostri prodotti vengono spediti dalla Polonia, quindi in alcuni paesi possono essere applicati costi di importazione. Questi costi non riguardano i paesi UE, il Regno Unito e gli Stati Uniti. In caso di dubbi, ci contatti per i dettagli.

pt.title: Border Terrier urna personalizada para cinzas de cão, feita à mão, de madeira com retrato da raça prateado
pt.description:

A forma compacta fica bem numa prateleira, aparador ou parapeito, em qualquer lugar onde goste de recordar o seu cão. Cada urna é feita por encomenda: indique-nos o nome e as datas de vida para uma placa e na outra mantenha as nossas palavras ou escolha as suas.

O QUE DEVE SABER SOBRE A URNA

- Pequeno relevo da raça Border Terrier na frente, em liga de zinco e alumínio, revestido com uma camada de prata; o relevo não pode ser personalizado
- Duas placas gravadas, uma acima da outra: uma com citação, outra com nome e datas de vida
- Dimensões exteriores: 21 x 29 x 11 cm (8,3 x 11,4 x 4,3 polegadas)
- Dimensões interiores: 21 x 14 x 5 cm (8,3 x 5,5 x 2,0 polegadas), capacidade aprox. 1,5 litros (92 polegadas cúbicas)
- Decorações de madeira entalhada
- Tampa amovível, não estanque: para fechar bem a urna, cole-a com cola universal

O RELEVO PRATEADO
Do lado direito da frente encontra-se um pequeno relevo com a cabeça da raça Border Terrier, revestido com uma camada de prata que lhe dá um brilho suave sobre a madeira escura. Ao lado há duas placas gravadas, uma acima da outra, com as suas palavras, o nome e as datas de vida.

PERSONALIZAÇÃO
Cada urna é feita por encomenda. Indique-nos:
- Nome e datas de vida: o nome e as datas de vida para a placa inferior, em qualquer formato.
- Citação: a placa superior leva o texto "You left our lives, but you will never leave our hearts" (apenas em inglês), a menos que nos indique o seu próprio texto exato.
- O relevo não pode ser personalizado.

Tem dúvidas sobre a personalização da urna? Escreva-nos, teremos todo o gosto em ajudar.

Será uma honra para nós ajudar a dar um adeus digno ao seu cão.

ENCOMENDAS INTERNACIONAIS
Os nossos produtos são enviados da Polónia, pelo que em alguns países podem ser aplicados custos de importação. Estes custos não se aplicam aos países da UE, ao Reino Unido nem aos Estados Unidos. Em caso de dúvida, contacte-nos para obter detalhes.

sv.title: Border Terrier personlig urna för aska efter hund, handgjord, i trä med försilvrat rasporträtt

På höger sida av framsidan sitter en liten relief med huvudet av rasen Border Terrier, belagd med ett lager silver som ger den en mjuk glans mot det mörka träet. Bredvid finns två graverade skyltar, den ena ovanför den andra, med dina ord, namn och levnadsdatum.

en.title: Central Asia Shepherd Silver Relief Cremation Urn for Your Dog, Handmade Compact Wooden Memorial
en.description:
A small silver plated relief of Alabay sits on the front of this handmade wooden urn, made to hold the ashes of your dog. Keep it where the family gathers, and let the silver relief bring back the face you loved. Add the name and dates of your dog, and choose the words for the quote plaque or keep ours.

THE URN AT A GLANCE
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, made of solid wood and plywood, painted brown
- Small relief portrait of a Central Asia Shepherd on the front, made of a zinc and aluminium alloy and covered with a layer of silver; the relief cannot be personalised
- Two engraved plaques, one above the other: one with a quote, one with the name and dates
- External size: 21 x 29 x 11 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 4.3 in)
- Internal size: 21 x 14 x 5 cm (8.3 x 5.5 x 2.0 in), capacity approx. 1.5 litres (92 cubic inches)
- Carved wooden decorations
- Removable lid, not sealed: glue it with any all-purpose glue to close it tightly

THE SILVER RELIEF
On the right of the front panel sits a small relief with the head of a Central Asia Shepherd, finished with a layer of silver that gives it a soft shine against the dark wood. It rests beside two engraved plaques, one above the other, with your words, the name and the dates.

PERSONALISATION
Every urn is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name and dates: the name and dates for the lower plaque, in any format you like.
- Quote: the upper plaque carries "You left our lives, but you will never leave our hearts" unless you give us your own exact wording.
- The relief cannot be personalised.

Questions about personalising your urn? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved companion with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

de.title: Mittelasiatischer Schäferhund Kremationsurne mit versilbertem Relief für Ihren Hund, handgefertigtes kleines Andenken aus Holz
